added_without_guide.0.45.3: Frame Link routes for the phone app (usage and pace, a queued message sent now or withdrawn, pictures sent with a message); nothing new on the desktop's screen. The app's own guide entries come with its build.
added_without_guide.0.45.4: The sign-in card shows only in a conversation whose last turn says the sign-in expired, and it explains each step itself; there is no fixed place on the screen to point at.
added_without_guide.0.46.0: Tasks are commands for the AI tabs (`sfctl task`, `--for-task`); nothing new on the desktop's screen yet. A page for them comes with its own entry.
added_without_guide.0.49.0: The office's panel gains a conversation and a message box; it lives inside the office (an iframe the tour cannot point into), so the office entry says it.
added_without_guide.0.50.0: The office's zoning select and Group card live inside the office (an iframe the tour cannot point into); the office entry covers the office.
added_without_guide.0.52.0: Ask to leave and pictures in the box live inside the office's panel (an iframe the tour cannot point into); the office entry covers the office.
added_without_guide.0.53.0: What already works shows on the Connect page's existing rows and cards, which the connect entry points to; its body says so. No new place on the screen.
added_without_guide.0.55.0: Plaud is one more row on the Connect page, which the connect entry points to; the task board and the schedule calendar live inside the office (an iframe the tour cannot point into), which the office entry covers; `sfctl connect step` is a command for the AI tabs.
added_without_guide.0.55.2: Command-line pairing (`sfctl link-pair --mode`, `link-join`, `link-enable`) is for the AI tabs and headless machines; nothing new on the desktop's screen (the Pair window already offers the three directions).
added_without_guide.0.56.0: The whiteboard's sticky notes and card actions and the calendar's day / week / month views live inside the office (an iframe the tour cannot point into); the office entry covers the office.
added_without_guide.0.57.0: A paired computer's main bot and whiteboard live inside the office's rooms (an iframe the tour cannot point into), and the top bar's narrow-window layout has no new control; the office entry covers the office.

body.en: Start Claude Code, Codex or another AI CLI, or a plain terminal. On macOS and Linux a tab keeps running when ShellBot restarts.
body.zh: 開 Claude Code、Codex 或其他 AI CLI，也可以開一般終端機。在 macOS 和 Linux 上，ShellBot 重啟時分頁會繼續跑。

body.en: Every tab is listed here. Click one to switch to it, double-click to rename it. The circular arrows beside the heading check every tab's state again.
body.zh: 所有分頁都列在這裡。點一下切換，點兩下改名。標題旁的循環箭頭會重新判斷每個分頁的狀態。

body.en: Search by name, job or latest line. The chips show only bots or only the other tabs, only idle ones or the ones quiet for 30 minutes, and can put the latest answer first.
body.zh: 用名稱、執掌或最新一句搜尋。下面的泡泡可以只看 Bot 或一般分頁、只看閒置或超過 30 分鐘沒動靜的，也可以把最近回應的排在上面。

body.en: A tab's light becomes a face: idle, working, a question for you, stuck, done. A tab can become a bot that wakes with its job, skills and memory, and writes its memory before it closes.
body.zh: 分頁的燈號變成 bot 的臉：發呆、運作中、有問題要問你、卡住、完成。分頁可以開成 bot，叫醒時帶著執掌、skill 和記憶，關閉前先把記憶寫好。

body.en: Read a tab as a conversation, or switch to its live terminal.
body.zh: 分頁可以用對話的樣子看，也可以切回即時的終端機。

body.en: The circular arrows on an AI tab restart its CLI to pick up an update. Claude Code and Codex come back to the same conversation.
body.zh: AI 分頁上的循環箭頭會重啟它的 CLI、套用更新。Claude Code 和 Codex 會接回同一段對話。

body.en: How much of each AI account's 5-hour and weekly allowance is used. Click for the details and the pace.
body.zh: 每個 AI 帳號的 5 小時和每週額度用了多少。點開看細節和用量速度。

body.en: Shows a pairing code and a QR code. Scan it with the ShellBot app on an iPhone or iPad, or enter the code on another computer, to see and drive these tabs from there.
body.zh: 顯示配對碼和 QR code。用 iPhone、iPad 上的 ShellBot App 掃，或在另一台電腦輸入配對碼，就能從那邊看、操作這裡的分頁。

body.en: Talk to your tabs from Telegram: paste a bot token here and connect. Messages go to the primary bot, which can pass work to the others.
body.zh: 從 Telegram 跟分頁對話：在這裡貼上 bot token 再連線。訊息會送給主要 bot，它可以再把工作交給其他 bot。

body.en: The same for a LINE Official Account: its channel token and secret here, then connect.
body.zh: LINE 官方帳號也可以：在這裡填 channel token 和 secret，再連線。

body.en: The AI in a tab can send work or a note to another bot by its name, here or on a paired computer, and hand off a task that reports back. Off by default.
body.zh: 分頁裡的 AI 可以用名字把工作或訊息交給另一個 bot，這台或配對的電腦都可以，也能交辦一件事、做完回報。預設關閉。

body.en: Put roles in a group and send one message to all of them; the replies come back as one conversation. Off by default.
body.zh: 把角色組成群組，一則訊息送給全部成員，回覆合成一段對話。預設關閉。

body.en: A side panel with the conversations that run on a schedule (/loop, cron routines, scheduled tabs): when each wakes next and what it waits on. Off by default.
body.zh: 側邊面板列出按排程跑的對話（/loop、cron routine、排程開的分頁）：下次什麼時候醒、在等什麼。預設關閉。

body.en: The first button in the row at the top of the sidebar. A bot is a tab with its own name, face, job and memory. Tap it to see them; if Bots is off it shows what they do and turns them on.
body.zh: 側欄最上面那排的第一顆。Bot 是有自己名字、頭像、執掌和記憶的分頁。按它看你的 bot；還沒開的話，會先說明它做什麼，再幫你打開。

body.en: The second button in that row opens the office: every bot as a person at a desk, who is busy and who waits on you. Dashed means it is off; tap it to see what it does and turn it on.
body.zh: 那排的第二顆打開辦公室：每個 bot 是桌前的一個人，誰在忙、誰在等你一眼看完。虛線代表還沒開，按一下看它做什麼，再決定要不要打開。

body.en: The third button in the row at the top of the sidebar, in the terminal and the chat view alike, opens the whiteboard (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B). The count is what agents wait on you for: open a card and answer with Reply.
body.zh: 側欄最上面那排的第三顆（終端機、對話兩種畫面都有，快捷鍵 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B）打開白板。數字是 agent 在等你決定的事：點開卡片、按「回覆」就能回答，不用翻對話。

body.en: A list on the right of the chat view (a thin strip when the window is narrow; a capsule at the top right of the terminal) of what waits on you: tabs asking a question, with buttons, and decision cards you can answer in place.
body.zh: 對話畫面的右邊（窗口窄時收成一條窄邊；終端機畫面右上角是一顆膠囊）列出等你的事：正在問你問題的分頁（有按鈕可直接回答）、等你決定的卡片（可就地回覆）。

body.en: The 辦公室 button at the top of the sidebar opens an office floor: bots (staff) at desks, AI tabs that are not bots (interns) at a long table, subagents (part-timers) beside them. Click a person to read their conversation and message them. On for a new install.
body.zh: 側欄最上面的「辦公室」鈕會打開一層辦公室：bot（正職）坐自己的桌子，不是 bot 的 AI 分頁（實習生）坐長桌，subagent（工讀生）站在旁邊。誰在忙、等你、卡住，看圖就知道；點一個人就能看他的對話、直接傳話。新安裝預設打開。

body.en: In the office, the bookshelf on the lobby wall (or the 書櫃 button at the bottom right) shows each bot's memory, skills and session summaries, and the shared skills. Read only; the red number is bots whose memory is almost full.
body.zh: 辦公室大廳牆邊的書櫃（或右下角的「書櫃」鈕）收著每個 bot 的記憶、技能、對話摘要，和共用技能。只看不改；紅色數字是記憶快滿的 bot 數。

body.en: The cabinet next to the bookshelf (or the 人事 button) has one file per bot: its duty, the model it runs on, whether it is awake, its tasks and schedules. External and local-model bots are labelled. Read only; 編輯執掌 opens its settings.
body.zh: 書櫃旁的人事檔案櫃（或右下角的「人事」鈕）每個 bot 一份檔案：執掌、跑的模型、醒著或休息、手上任務和負責的排程。外部、地端模型的 bot 會標出來。只看不改；「編輯執掌」打開它的設定。

body.en: Files and links a bot or tab hands you land on its desk in the office as a pile of papers (the 交付物 button lists them all). Open one, then keep it on the desk, take it away, or ask the bot to change it.
body.zh: bot 或分頁交給你的檔案、連結，會放在它在辦公室的桌上，像一疊公文（右下角的「交付物」鈕看全部）。打開看，然後先放著、拿走，或請它改。

body.en: Below the decisions on the right: what was handed to you and not decided yet, with Open, Keep and Take. A paperclip with a number on a bot's or tab's avatar counts its new ones.
body.zh: 右邊「待你決定」的下面：交給你、還沒決定的東西，可以打開、先放著、拿走。側欄頭像和分頁上的迴紋針數字是它新的件數。

body.en: Categories on the left: General, Bots, Office, Loops, Launch presets, Connect, Telegram, LINE and Advanced. Launch commands show in full and can be edited, added and dragged; the ones few people change (local HTTP API, idle tab cleanup) are under Advanced.
body.zh: 左邊是分類：一般、Bots、辦公室、Loops・排程、預設指令、連結、Telegram、LINE、進階。啟動指令完整顯示，可以直接改、新增、拖曳排序；很少動的（本機 HTTP API、閒置分頁清理）在「進階」。

body.en: The AI in your tabs learns how to use ShellBot (open tabs, read other tabs, message them) from `sfctl skill`. This shows what it reads.
body.zh: 分頁裡的 AI 從 `sfctl skill` 學會怎麼用 ShellBot（開分頁、看別的分頁、傳訊息）。這裡看得到它讀的內容。

body.en: Open it again any time: every feature with where to find it, and what is new since you last looked.
body.zh: 隨時可以再打開：每個功能在哪裡、怎麼用，還有上次看過之後的新功能。

body.en: Settings → Connect lists the services your bots can use: search, pick a kind, see what is recommended and what is on this Mac. Press Connect: the service's page opens, and back here ShellBot tests it. What you already set up counts too; its row says which way.
body.zh: 設定 → 連結列出 bot 能用的服務：可以搜尋、按類別挑、看推薦的和這台 Mac 上的。按「連結」會打開那個服務的頁面，回到這裡 ShellBot 就自己測試。你自己已經設好的也算，那一列會寫走哪種方式。

body.en: Each tab on your computer is a bot here. Its face shows what it is doing: idle, working, or waiting on a question for you. Tap one to open the conversation.
body.zh: 電腦上的每個分頁，在這裡都是一個 bot。臉表示它現在在做什麼：發呆、在做事，或有問題等你回答。點一下打開對話。

body.en: The computer you paired. With several, switch between them here.
body.zh: 這是你配對的電腦。配了好幾台時，從這裡切換。

body.en: Open a new tab on this computer, or pair another computer.
body.zh: 在這台電腦開新分頁，或再配對一台電腦。

body.en: Show only idle bots or the ones quiet for a while, reorder or close tabs, refresh, or unpair.
body.zh: 只看閒置或很久沒動靜的 bot、排序和關閉分頁、重新整理、斷開配對。

body.en: Notifications, text size, your computers, and this guide: take the tour again or read what each feature does.
body.zh: 通知、字體、配對的電腦，還有這份導覽：可以再走一次，或看每個功能的說明。

body.en: Switch this conversation to its live terminal, or see what the bots sent each other.
body.zh: 把這段對話切到即時的終端機畫面，或看 bot 之間互相傳了什麼。

body.en: Type here to send it a message. When it asks you something, the choices appear above; tap one to answer.
body.zh: 在這裡打字傳給它。它有問題要問你時，選項會出現在上面，點一下就回答。
